pathways.compact_statement: Northern livelihood pressures may contribute to mobility and resource tensions.
alternative_explanations: Mobility and resource disputes can have non-climatic drivers.
pathways.uncertainty: Policy-brief risk through 2080; scenario unspecified and no causal conflict estimate.
recommendations: Retain only evidence whose documented geography supports the pathway location; otherwise narrow the pathway or keep the evidence standalone.

pathways.compact_statement: In Gushegu, reported heat-related herding adjustments can encounter crop/tree-tenure disputes within a politically mediated conflict setting; no independent climate effect is estimated.
alternative_explanations: Political mobilization, land acquisition, population pressure, crop damage, stigmatization and weak dispute mechanisms independently shape tensions.
pathways.uncertainty: A 2022 case-based brief and interviews, not a climate-attributable conflict estimate or current incident map. Ethnic identity is not treated as a propensity for violence.
recommendations: Retain only evidence whose documented geography supports the pathway location; otherwise narrow the pathway or keep the evidence standalone.
